Title: Generally Available: Azure Storage Mover with Bandwidth Management

Body.Content:
Azure Storage Mover now supports setting bandwidth management schedules for your Storage Mover agents to optimize your file migrations and ensuring a smooth network performance. This feature helps Storage Mover agents act as a good neighbor in your on-prem data centers by limiting how much WAN link upload bandwidth they may consume at any point of the day.

 Learn more about this feature: How to create, schedule and manage bandwidth limits for Azure Storage Mover
